title: Avoid single table prefix aggregate name display allocation
description: Replace single-table COUNT/MIN/MAX prefix aggregate dispatch via func.name.to_string().to_uppercase() with direct ObjectNamePart matching.

criteria: Single-table prefix aggregate optimization no longer builds uppercase display names before classifying supported functions
MIN/MAX primary-key prefix behavior remains unchanged

notes: The single-table aggregate optimization now maps COUNT, MIN, and MAX through direct ObjectNamePart comparisons.
Output column naming still uses the existing function display formatting.
Eligibility checks for COUNT arguments and MIN/MAX primary-key arguments are unchanged.
